messages.Accounts: Complete overview of all contacts / contact persons in a company, also you can see the communication history.
messages.Business: Manage your leads, convert a prospect into a contact, company, supplier or opportunity. An opportunity can be effortlessly converted into a quote and printed as a PDF file or sent via email. A quote can in turn be converted into an invoice, the same scheme of conversion applies here.
messages.Calendar: Never miss important appointments again! Schedule meetings or calls with our integrated calendar, use reminders via email, SMS or as a push-up window on your screen. Set up filters. Of course, you can also set up a shared calendar, so you can see exactly who is working on what or which employee is available for a task. The connection to your Google Calendar is self-evident.
messages.Campaigns: Always keep an eye on the budget for marketing projects. Create a monthly newsletter to strengthen customer relationships.
messages.Contacts: Complete overview of all contact persons / contact persons, also you can see the communication history.
messages.DashboardAndDashlets: Welcome to AutomaticERP, we start the tour guide and take you step-by-step through our intuitive low-code platform ({{dashboard_video}})
messages.Emails: Take advantage of the integrated email client. You will always have an overview, as the email traffic is directly linked to your leads. Of course, you can also create a task directly from a mail, mark it as important or forward it.
messages.Entities: Let's start from the Dashboard. On the left side you will find the menu bar. Each module (entity) is linked to the database.
messages.GlobalSearch: Quickly find what you are looking for e.g. name of a company, lead or project.
messages.Hint Not Available: Unfortunately, there is no hint available for this page.
messages.Home: Home page, you are currently here.
messages.Invoices: Use the possibilities of automation e.g. sending payment reminders!
messages.IssuedOrders: Are likewise linked to the associated project and also to your suppliers.
messages.KnowledgeBaseArticles: In our knowledge base you will find helpful videos that guide you through our low-code platform
messages.Leads: Managing your leads - In this tab you have the complete contact information and other relevant data about your 'prospects'.
messages.Mattermost: Reduce your email traffic! Communicate in real time with your team via the Mattermost chat tool. Upload documents, videos or images. Schedule online meetings. Create a new task directly from the chat and assign it to a team or user.
messages.Notifications: All notifications appear here, for example: the status of a task has been changed, you have received an e-mail or when a meeting has been held.
messages.Opportunities: Convert a lead into a sales opportunity. Calculate the probabilities of your deals.
messages.ProjectManagement: Manage your projects or tasks with the help of the Kanban board or the Gannt diagram.
messages.QuestionMark: Are you lost? Click here to get help about the currently opened page.
messages.QuickCreate: Create a new entity with just a few clicks, e.g.: Contact, Meeting, Email or Task.
messages.Quotes: Create a quote with a few clicks which you can print directly in your PDF design or send by email. Choose items from the templates and add them.
messages.Reporting: Create reports from any entity and have a complete overview of your running costs and resources - monthly closings become a breeze.
messages.SalesOrders: Keep track of your orders - link them directly to the associated project.
messages.Settings: Here you can e.g. manage your user account. Under 'Administration' you get to the back office of AutomaticERP.
messages.WarehouseManagement: Loading and unloading in real time, you always have your stock under control and simplify your inventory.
messages.Welcome to AutoCRM: Welcome to AutomaticERP.com, a customized software for your business. This CRM system grows with your team and your processes.
